quotes.text: ClinEnv is derived from MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-IV-Note, which are de-identified and distributed through PhysioNet under a credentialed data use agreement

parsed.rationale: Origin (MIMIC-IV, one US academic medical center) and terms (credentialed DUA, de-identified) are stated. No consent or IRB status, and no explicit 'not required', is given, and the original collection method is not described, so the 2 anchor is not met.
